## `set_full_project_path`

*Available in [R](#set_full_project_path-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Sets the default full path to the project.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    set_full_project_path(path = "")

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `path` - full path to the project folder

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    message indicating the path has been saved.
